articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: SUI drops 4.9%, as index trades lower
articles.snippet: Bittensor (TAO), down 4.4% from Monday, joined Sui (SUI) as an underperformer.

articles.title: Bitcoin hovers above key support as equities, crypto retreat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and ether fell as escalating Middle East tensions lifted oil and the dollar, though BTC continued to hold above a key bull market level.

articles.title: Exodus sells over 1,000 Bitcoin as Q1 loss widens to $32M
articles.snippet: Exodus Movement reported a $32.1 million net loss in Q1, with revenue down 36.8% to $22.7 million amid a drop in monthly active users.

articles.title: Bhutan’s GMC offers quick licenses, bank accounts to lure crypto firms
articles.snippet: Gelephu Mindfulness City in Bhutan is offering a faster licensing track with banking and zero‑tax incentives to attract regulated crypto firms willing to build long‑term operations.

articles.title: Rewardy Wallet launches global multi-chain swap campaign with incentives
articles.snippet: Self-custody wallet by Chainwith opens two-week user activation across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, and Aptos, with prizes starting at $100.
